paper.title: ARISE: Agent Reasoning with Intrinsic Skill Evolution in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
paper.central_claim: 共享policy端到端优化技能选择、生成与解题，使非权重技能库和权重共演化，改善数学推理尤其OOD迁移。

provenance.notes: 派发 type=sonnet；环境声明 gpt-6.1-sol，无独立模型回执/session ID，按模板保存 null；未探测。

sections_read: Appendices A–E, all text, equations, Tables 3–10 and captions

evidence.quote: In Phase I, the policy is warmed up with standard GRPO on binary task rewards while the skill library is silently populated from successful traces.
evidence.support_explanation: 任务反馈生成并留存非权重技能，不因伴随RL而按A3排除。

evidence.quote: freezes the library at 24 seed skills
evidence.support_explanation: 有静态库对照，但与附录5 seeds不一致。

evidence.quote: In each run the model generates a single solution per problem with greedy decoding
evidence.support_explanation: 32 evaluation runs不是32独立训练seed；确定性解码未解释变化来源。

evidence.quote: For in-distribution benchmarks (AMC 2023, AIME 2024&2025), answers are verified by exact numerical match.
If any reservoir skill has a utility estimate exceeding that of the lowest-utility cache entry, the two are swapped.
evidence.support_explanation: 只读cache且reservoir不再获得使用反馈，重新相关性恢复条件薄弱。
新技能初始低utility会被立即逐出，缺探索保护。

evidence.quote: The generated output undergoes a four-stage validation pipeline before entering the library:
evidence.support_explanation: 入库是格式/长度验证，不是技能效果测试。

evidence.quote: evaluating Pass@1 accuracy on AIME 2024 with all other settings fixed at their defaults.
evidence.support_explanation: 报告集兼作超参数敏感性选择证据；不能全称独立held-out。
实际训练额外开销已披露，不等compute matched。

evidence.quote: The proxy IG serves primarily as a diagnostic tool rather than a training signal.
evidence.support_explanation: IG不是skill admission因果门控；proxy比较全局非配对。

evidence.quote: Skills not selected in this step retain their previous utility.
evidence.support_explanation: 被放入reservoir的技能无反馈更新恢复通道。

evidence.quote: correct-but-unaugmented solutions are actively down-weighted relative to skill-augmented ones.
evidence.support_explanation: reward鼓励使用并不证明技能增量贡献。

evidence.quote: Be generic and transferable; do not copy specific numbers.
evidence.support_explanation: 成功轨迹抽象成可复用技能，且后续注入。

signatures.conditions: 可验证数学任务；格式合法技能；训练/部署均使用技能注入
signatures.feedback: exact-match/symbolic task reward；正确+skill使用给2，无skill正确给1；utility EMA0.9
signatures.selection_rule: JSON/长度验证入库，cache utility逐出，softmax confidence0.35检索；无配对效果准入
signatures.selection_data: 训练轨迹用于库；AIME24做超参敏感性
signatures.persistence: cache/reservoir非权重JSON，跨题复用；权重并行更新
signatures.later_use: 后续training与evaluation经cache选技能前置到prompt
